title: SemanticSpaceProjection
description:
Frozen projection snapshot of the admitted semantic substrate.

It contains schema-level possibility and instance-level actuality for canonical objects, regions, units, identifiers, occurrences, anchors, surfaces, and transitions. It is structural authority for a snapshot only; it may not infer, activate, query, conform, retrieve, or synthesize.

configuration_snapshot_id.description: Configuration snapshot governing represented bounds and capabilities.

corpus_snapshot_identity.description: Identity of the admitted corpus snapshot.

ingest_identity.description: Identity of the ingest state from which this projection was materialized.

logical_hash.description: Stable logical hash for equivalent projected input state.

object_classes.description: Schema-level classes of semantic object represented in the snapshot.

occurrences.description: Actual authored occurrences and resolved canonical targets.

projection_snapshot_id.description: Immutable snapshot identity used throughout one turn.

valid_transitions.description: Valid structural transitions represented by the snapshot.

validation_status.description: Declared validation state of the frozen representation.

AddressKind.description:
Stable categories of address represented by the projection.

These labels describe structural input and output kinds. They do not judge semantic relevance or establish that a requested address exists.

oneOf.description: Authored region address within an object.

AuthoredBlockType.description:
Authored block categories that may materialize one semantic unit.

The variants preserve source form and cannot split a canonical unit based on provider limits.

BlockTargetMapping.description:
Mapping from an authored block target to one canonical semantic unit.

It preserves target resolution only and cannot invent a block target from a heuristic string match.

target_unit_id.description: Canonical semantic unit resolved at ingest or projection time.

CoverageSemantics.description:
Measurable coverage behavior declared for a surface.

Coverage constrains later claim scope; it does not reinterpret returned units or score problem-space coherence.

oneOf.description: Eligible scope can be exhaustively enumerated and counted.
Results are deterministically bounded and may be incomplete.
Surface reports availability but no stronger coverage guarantee.

Direction.description:
Explicit direction for a represented structural connection.

Direction authorizes no traversal by itself; it is valid only when the projection represents the requested incidence.

oneOf.description: Move from source incidence toward its represented target.
Move from a target toward represented incoming incidence.

IdentifierAddress.description:
Address of an identifier descriptor or assignment.

It represents a named projected surface and optional represented value. It cannot replace canonical object or unit identity.

identifier_name.description: Identifier name represented by the projection.

represented_value.description: Optional exact represented value used to address one assignment.

IdentifierAssignment.description:
Actual assignment of one admitted identifier to one projected address.

It preserves descriptor name, subject, represented value, and provenance. It cannot change the subject's canonical identity or upgrade contextual participation into intrinsic typing.

subject.description: Canonical subject that carries or participates in the assignment.

value.description: Scalar or collection value matching the descriptor's declared shape.

IdentifierAssignmentMode.description:
Provenance and inheritance mode of an identifier assignment.

This distinction prevents contextual participation from being flattened into intrinsic object typing. It does not itself propagate assignments.

oneOf.description: Inherited from a canonical parent object with provenance retained.
Authored locally on a region or unit.
Contextual relation whose source and target remain distinct.

IdentifierCardinality.description:
Cardinality of an identifier assignment.

It is a structural schema constraint only.

IdentifierDescriptor.description:
Descriptor of one admitted identifier.

It states role, shape, applicability, provenance mode, temporal and link affordances, capable surfaces, and enabled transitions. It does not assign a value or create a relation by itself.

applicable_address_kinds.description: Address kinds to which this identifier may structurally apply.

assignment_mode.description: How assignment provenance participates in inheritance and relation.

enabled_transition_ids.description: Transition identities enabled by this descriptor.

may_contain_canonical_links.description: Whether values may contain canonical authored links.

retrieval_surface_ids.description: Surfaces structurally capable of inspecting the representation.

semantic_role.description: Semantic role in the authored substrate.

temporal_affordance.description: Temporal affordance supplied by this identifier.

IdentifierRole.description:
Semantic role of an admitted identifier.

Roles preserve typing discipline. They do not determine truth, relevance, or whether an assignment answers a current problem.

oneOf.description: Canonical naming, title, alias, or attribution.
Contextual relation to another canonical address.
Indexical telemetry carried by authored source material.
Named admitted role not hard-coded as corpus content.

IdentifierValue.description:
Value carried by one identifier assignment.

This is a closed structural union for exchange. It cannot be interpreted as evidence or a relation without its descriptor and provenance.

IdentifierValueShape.description:
JSON-compatible value shapes admitted for identifier assignments.

The shape constrains serialization and conformance only. It does not assign semantic meaning beyond the descriptor's declared role.

OccurrencePresentation.description:
Presentation form of an authored occurrence.

Presentation does not create a second target object or change canonical identity.

OccurrenceRecord.description:
One authored occurrence with its resolved canonical target and provenance.

It is an addressable record rather than an untyped edge. It preserves authored text, source surface, direction, and target identity but cannot invent or semantically label a relation after retrieval.

authored_target_text.description: Authored target text before canonical resolution.

resolved_target.description: Canonical object, region, or unit target resolved by projection.

OccurrenceSource.description:
Authored source surface of one occurrence.

It distinguishes object-field, semantic-region marker, and semantic-unit body contexts and cannot transfer identifiers between source and target.

oneOf.description: Occurrence authored in an object field.
Occurrence authored in a canonical semantic-region marker, such as a heading containing a link without any unit-worthy authored block.
Occurrence authored in a semantic unit body.

ProjectionValidationStatus.description:
Validation state attached to a frozen projection representation.

This is recorded projection metadata. The enum does not validate anything and does not convert an invalid snapshot into a usable one.

oneOf.description: Snapshot has passed the accepted structural validation process.
Snapshot exists but has not yet been structurally validated.
Snapshot is retained for diagnostics but is structurally invalid.

RecordProvenance.description:
Provenance of a projected or retrieved fact.

It records where a fact was materialized from. It may not upgrade source authority or turn contextual participation into intrinsic typing.

oneOf.description: Frontmatter field on a canonical source object.

object_id.description: Canonical object that owns the field.

oneOf.description: Authored body span inside a canonical semantic unit.

unit_id.description: Canonical semantic unit containing the source.

rule.description: Named materialization rule or contract source.

sources.description: Source record addresses used by the rule.

RetrievalSurfaceAddress.description:
Address of a retrieval-surface descriptor.

It names a projected capability only. It does not execute the surface or imply that the surface is available for a particular address.

RetrievalSurfaceDescriptor.description:
Descriptor of one retrieval-surface capability in a frozen projection.

It declares availability, visible address kinds, modes, bounds, returned identity, hydration, coverage semantics, continuation, and limitations. It does not execute a query or judge semantic adequacy.

available.description: Whether the concrete surface is available in this configuration.

continuation_supported.description: Whether bounded continuation is structurally available.

coverage_semantics.description: Measurable coverage behavior of the surface.

exhaustive_total_count_supported.description: Whether a complete eligible-scope total count is supported.

hydrates_to_semantic_units.description: Whether results deterministically hydrate to canonical semantic units.

match_modes.description: Query or match modes accepted by the surface.

returned_identity.description: Canonical or projected identity returned directly by the surface.

visible_address_kinds.description: Address kinds the surface may structurally inspect.

RetrievalSurfaceKind.description:
Retrieval-surface families admitted by the contracts.

A family describes a capability class only; the projection determines whether a concrete surface exists and what it may inspect.

SemanticAddress.description:
Canonical or projected address used by plans and provenance records.

It can point only to represented address categories. It does not prove that the target exists in a given snapshot; structural conformance owns that later check.

SemanticObjectClassDescriptor.description:
Schema-level descriptor of a represented semantic-object class.

It declares possible identifiers and source kinds for conformance. It does not instantiate objects or hard-code corpus-specific semantic content.

applicable_identifier_names.description: Identifier names structurally applicable to this class.

permitted_source_kinds.description: Source kinds from which this class may be materialized.

SemanticObjectRecord.description:
Canonical semantic-object instance in one projection snapshot.

It preserves identity, source topology, contained addresses, occurrence incidence, anchors, and surface affordances. It does not select access or collapse discovery surfaces into canonical identity.

body_occurrence_ids.description: Occurrences authored in non-frontmatter body syntax, including semantic-unit bodies and semantic-region markers.

canonical_path.description: Canonical source path or topology address.

filename.description: Authored filename or source display surface.

identifier_assignment_ids.description: Identifier assignments carried by the object.

retrieval_surface_ids.description: Retrieval surfaces structurally capable of inspecting this object.

source_identity.description: Stable source identity from which the object was materialized.

temporal_anchor_ids.description: Temporal anchors materially attached to the object.

SemanticRegionAddress.description:
Address of an authored structural region inside one semantic object.

The address preserves both the canonical parent object and a non-empty authored structural address. It has no authority to select a unit, infer a heading target, or treat the region as a separate epistemic object class.

authored_structural_address.description: Non-empty authored heading, block, or structural address.

SemanticRegionRecord.description:
Canonical addressable authored region within one semantic object.

It preserves heading topology, contained regions and units, target mappings, inherited identifiers, incidence, and affordances. It cannot arbitrarily collapse a multi-unit heading to one unit or become a separate ontology.

address.description: Canonical parent object plus authored structural address.

block_target_mappings.description: Deterministic block-target mappings declared inside the region.

contained_unit_ids.description: Canonical semantic units contained by the region.

heading_identity.description: Stable heading or region identity within the projection snapshot.

heading_path.description: Authored hierarchy from the object root to this region.

inherited_identifier_assignment_ids.description: Inherited identifier assignments visible at the region.

outgoing_occurrence_ids.description: Authored occurrences whose syntax occurs in this region marker.

retrieval_surface_ids.description: Retrieval surfaces capable of inspecting the region.

source_span.description: Source span of the authored region marker when known.

SemanticUnitContent.description:
Canonical unit content representation.

It either carries authored material directly or a deterministic hydration address. It does not carry normalized text as a replacement authority.

oneOf.description: Authored Markdown or source block is present in the projection.

normalized_text.description: Deterministic normalized representation used by capable surfaces.

oneOf.description: Full content is available through a deterministic read-only address.

address.description: Stable address understood by the substrate adapter.

content_hash.description: Integrity hash of the hydrated authored content.

SemanticUnitRecord.description:
Canonical independently addressable authored semantic unit.

It preserves object and region belonging, authored block structure, content or hydration address, inherited and local identifiers, occurrences, anchors, source provenance, and subordinate transport segments. It cannot be manufactured from a provider token limit or semantically filtered here.

authored_block_type.description: Authored Markdown or source block category.

block_ordinal.description: One-based ordinal within the authored region.

content.description: Authored content or deterministic hydration address.

explicit_block_id.description: Explicit authored block identifier when present.

inherited_identifier_assignment_ids.description: Identifier assignments inherited from the parent object.

outgoing_occurrence_ids.description: Authored outgoing occurrences from the unit.

parent_region_address.description: Canonical authored region containing the unit.

retrieval_surface_ids.description: Retrieval surfaces capable of inspecting or hydrating the unit.

source_provenance.description: Materialization provenance for the canonical unit.

temporal_anchor_ids.description: Temporal anchors materially attached to the unit.

transport_segments.description: Technical segments subordinate to this one canonical unit.

unit_local_identifier_assignment_ids.description: Identifier assignments authored locally on the unit.

SourceKind.description:
Authored source kinds admitted by the projection contract.

These values describe source form only. They do not determine semantic relevance, register, or corpus admission by themselves.

oneOf.description: Another explicitly admitted source kind named by configuration.

SourceSpan.description:
Authored or materialized source span.

This is provenance for a represented record. It cannot reinterpret the source or establish semantic relevance.

end_byte.description: Exclusive ending byte offset when known.

source.description: Source path or stable source identity.

start_byte.description: Inclusive starting byte offset when known.

StructuralTransition.description:
Valid structural transition represented by a projection snapshot.

It states a possible typed move between address kinds and optional surface. It does not perform the move or determine whether a concrete instance path answers the current problem.

operation.description: Structural operation represented by the transition.

retrieval_surface_id.description: Surface required by the transition when applicable.

StructuralTransitionOperation.description:
Structural operation families represented by projection transitions.

Variants are possibility grammar, not execution methods or semantic judges.

oneOf.description: Unit or region to canonical parent.
Incoming or outgoing authored occurrence incidence.
Deterministic hydration to canonical semantic units.

SurfaceMatchMode.description:
Query or match modes exposed by a retrieval surface.

Modes constrain execution shape only and do not imply semantic relevance.

oneOf.description: Named configured mode not hard-coded as corpus meaning.

TemporalAffordance.description:
Temporal affordance of one identifier descriptor.

It declares structural time-bearing capacity only and does not evaluate or compare temporal values.

oneOf.description: No temporal anchor is created or referenced.
Assignment may materialize a temporal anchor.
Assignment may point to an existing anchor.

TemporalAnchorRecord.description:
Materially sourced temporal anchor attached to a canonical address.

It preserves temporal value and provenance. It cannot compare dates, generate chronology, or make a contextual date intrinsic to a target object.

provenance.description: Exact source provenance of the anchor.

subject.description: Canonical object or unit to which the anchor is materially attached.

TemporalValue.description:
Structured temporal value represented by a temporal anchor.

It preserves authored precision and does not perform ordering or inference.

oneOf.description: Calendar date in ISO-like authored form.
Date and time with an explicit offset or zone in authored form.
Named temporal label when no stronger syntax is admitted.

TransportSegmentRecord.description:
Technical transport segment subordinate to one canonical semantic unit.

It preserves parent identity, order, source span, and reconstruction data. It may serve provider transport but can never become independent evidence or a canonical semantic unit.

parent_unit_id.description: Canonical semantic unit that owns the segment.

source_span.description: Source span covered by the segment.

total_segments.description: Total segment count needed for complete reconstruction.
